data.overview: In 1930s Italy, airborne raiders prey on ships crossing the Adriatic. Their chief obstacle is Marco Rossetti, a decorated wartime pilot inexplicably transformed into a pig. With a gifted young mechanic and an old friend at his side, Marco prepares to face the raiders' celebrated American ace.
data.tagline: The sky belongs to the bravest.
data.title: The Crimson Aviator
